calculate_elastic_tensor: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for an ASE Atoms structure
compute_bulk_modulus: use calculate_elasticity with default strains to get the bulk modulus VRH value from the returned results dictionary
compute_shear_modulus: use calculate_elasticity with custom norm_strains and shear_strains to get the shear modulus VRH value
calculate_elasticity_with_relaxation: run calculate_elasticity with relax_initial and relax_strained set to True to relax both the initial and deformed structures
calculate_elasticity_without_equilibrium: run calculate_elasticity with use_equilibrium_stress set to False to skip using equilibrium stress in the calculation
